inferred_from_public_evidence: The market will need a trust/action layer above individual tools and traces.
Buyers will value proof before external action where agents touch customers, money, or enterprise systems.
internal_hypothesis: Y* can be recognized as a distinctive action-trust layer if the first demo makes intent/action/evidence/learning visibly inseparable.
unsupported_do_not_use: Any claim that buyers have validated or paid for Y*.
Any claim that Y* is certified or production-ready for regulated enterprise deployment.

historical_direction_of_ai_agency: AI is moving from conversation and content generation toward systems that call tools, coordinate with other agents, access enterprise systems, and initiate delegated commercial actions.
institutional_void: Enterprises lack a complete layer that proves whether an agent action is authorized, evidenced, replayable, accountable, and learnable before and after execution.
market_urgency: Protocols and platforms are enabling action faster than governance, identity, proof, and business accountability practices can mature.
ontological_shift_in_action: Software is no longer only a passive tool. Agentic systems increasingly become bounded actors that transform intent into operations across tools, protocols, and organizations.
